# Requirements Quality Checklist: Existing Combat Tracker Baseline

**Purpose**: Validate that the migrated brownfield baseline spec is complete, clear, consistent, and ready to guide future spec-driven work.
**Created**: 2026-06-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Items test the quality of the requirements, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are campaign roster requirements complete for create, open, edit, active/inactive characters, and shared campaign resources? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are encounter lifecycle requirements complete for create, update, activate, restart, list, and soft-delete operations? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are combat action requirements complete for resource changes, typed/location damage, healing, defeated state, and party character persistence? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-005-FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are monster template reuse requirements complete for saving, de-duplicating, listing, and loading reusable NPC profiles? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK005 Are local persistence requirements complete for database path selection, migration startup, normalized stats, and generated schema artifacts? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 5, Spec §FR-010-FR-011]
- [x] CHK006 Are desktop UI requirements complete for no-campaign, no-encounter, active encounter, and post-action refresh states? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 6, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "shared campaign resources" defined clearly enough to distinguish campaign-level Party AP/GM Threat from encounter-local state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Is "party character persistence" specified clearly enough to describe which combatant updates propagate back to campaign characters? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK009 Is "unique monster templates are upserted by name" precise about case-sensitivity, trimming, and duplicate handling expectations? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 4]
- [x] CHK010 Is "responsive dialogs" defined with measurable or reviewable criteria for a native Fyne desktop app? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 6]
- [x] CHK011 Is the encounter difficulty requirement clear about thresholds, labels, and how party average level and enemy XP interact? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Spec §Known Gaps]
- [x] CHK012 Is the scope of "operation logs for major combat and encounter operations" enumerated or bounded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Are campaign resource requirements consistent between campaign roster management, encounter creation, and combat resource actions? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK014 Are persistence requirements consistent between Key Entities and Functional Requirements for campaigns, encounters, combatants, monster templates, stat profiles, and encounter logs? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §FR-010-FR-013]
- [x] CHK015 Are UI requirements consistent with the stated local desktop/offline assumptions and the single-user scope? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 6, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK016 Are migrated Known Gaps consistent with unchecked follow-up tasks and not contradicted by Success Criteria? [Consistency, Spec §Success Criteria, Spec §Known Gaps, Tasks §Phase 9]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Are acceptance scenarios specific enough to distinguish primary, alternate, and failure flows for campaign editing and inactive characters? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK018 Are encounter acceptance scenarios measurable for initiative order, round wrapping, defeated combatants, and saved encounter operations? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK019 Are combat action acceptance scenarios measurable for AP cap, insufficient resources, resistance/immunity behavior, and revive behavior? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK020 Are persistence acceptance scenarios measurable for default DB path, override DB path, parent directory creation, and normalized resistance consistency? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 5]
- [x] CHK021 Are success criteria written as requirement-quality outcomes rather than only implementation/test outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are exception-flow requirements documented for missing active campaign, missing active encounter, invalid campaign ID, invalid encounter ID, and repository not-found cases? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are recovery-flow requirements documented for migration failure, database open failure, and partial write/transaction failure scenarios? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §User Story 5]
- [x] CHK024 Are alternate-flow requirements documented for manual combatants, loaded party members, loaded monster templates, and duplicated party member selection? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Are state-refresh requirements specified for every state-changing UI workflow, including campaign edit, encounter edit, launch, restart, delete, damage, heal, and resource changes? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 6]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK026 Are numeric boundary requirements complete for HP, max HP, level, XP, initiative, defense, resistance, Party AP, and GM Threat? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-005-FR-008]
- [x] CHK027 Are body-location and damage-type edge cases complete for poison global-only behavior, torso-only mapping, unknown locations, and immunity flags? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-007-FR-008]
- [x] CHK028 Are audit-log failure requirements complete for what must still succeed, what must be recorded, and what remains observable to a user or maintainer? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK029 Are `.agents/` safety requirements complete enough to prevent accidental credential storage while preserving checked-in Spec Kit skills? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Known Gaps, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions
